criteria.description: Replication sanity (not a kill): D2 reproduces Joshi's ordering none << GDC < AdaBS at 1 d and 1 yr (sign agreement; magnitude within a factor 2 of +0.9 pt at 1 d). Gross mismatch means the drift model or bridge is wrong, which blocks everything downstream.
criteria.note: "magnitude within a factor 2 of +0.9 pt at 1 d" is read as gain in [0.45, 1.8] pt. The plan does not name which gain (AdaBS minus GDC is the natural reading). Script emits h31_ordering_ok (0/1) and h31_gain_1d_pt.

criteria.description: Headroom gate for A: headroom := top-1(oracle-or-FullReadout) - top-1(best incumbent among B1-B3) averaged over 3 seeds. A is ALLOWED to proceed only if headroom >= 1.0 pt at >= 2 time points for at least one of {D2 with drift_scale in {1,2}, D3 rho <= 2, D4} and sign-consistent across seeds.
criteria.note: Script sets bool column h32_model_eligible for rows in the allowed model set and emits per-model h32_n_timepoints_ge_1pt and h32_sign_consistent_across_seeds. Pass if ANY eligible model qualifies (max over eligible models of the pass flag).

criteria.description: Else KILL A as a network-accuracy story (it may survive purely as "cheaper than AdaBS/per-column" with a cost model - say so).
criteria.note: Exact complement of H3.2 on the same metrics (no eligible model reaches 2 time points with consistent sign).

criteria.description: Under mismatch factor >= 1.25 (drift_scale or Ea deviating from nominal) the timer baseline B6 loses >= 1.0 pt to B1a at >= 1 time point (confirms the research-05 row-2 gap exists in the simulator). If not, "sensing beats timer" has no motivation.

Watchdog value: AUC of (|alpha_GDC - 1|, sigma_1 ratio, sum-current) for detecting "GDC residual > 1 pt equivalent eps" along drift trajectories. KILL M1-as-watchdog if its AUC < 0.7 or is not >= 0.05 above the free GDC-factor statistic's AUC.
Research-03's E4 kill: stop the vertical if GDC / per-column / a rank-r probe correction (k <= 4, P <= 4) recovers >= 90% of what the spectral tracker recovers on every non-uniform field.
criteria.note: Script emits b5_recovery_fraction_of_spectral per non-uniform drift field; 'every field' => min.

criteria.description: If t* < 1 day at nominal D2 for T=256, B's plan MUST include a drift-aware reference (low-rank + sparse); otherwise the plain residual is adequate for deployment-scale horizons.
criteria.note: Decision rule for plan-B scoping, not a pass/fail on a claim, hence kind report (condition recorded; true = B must include a drift-aware reference). 1 day = 86400 s.
